items.title: WordPress Malware Uses Hidden Plugin and Blockchain C2 to Stay Undetected
items.description: A newly identified WordPress malware strain is using a hidden plugin, stolen administrator access, and a blockchain-based command channel to remain active on compromised websites. The threat is built to survive common cleanup efforts while quietly collecting sensitive data from affected servers. The malware is installed as a must-use plugin, a type of WordPress component […] The post WordPress…

items.title: Check Point Patches Exploited Management Server Zero-Day
items.description: The critical-severity flaw could allow unauthenticated attackers to upload and execute arbitrary scripts. The post Check Point Patches Exploited Management Server Zero-Day appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: ShinyHunters Claims FBI Breach, Says It Stole Data on Agents and Job Applicants
items.description: The cyber extortion group known as ShinyHunters on Tuesday claimed it had breached the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation and stolen data belonging to current and former employees at the agency. "We have compromised the FBI. items.title: Hackers Exploiting F5 BIG-IP OAuth Server 0-day Flaw to Gain Remote Code Execution
items.description: F5 has warned that hackers are actively exploiting a critical zero-day vulnerability in BIG-IP Access Policy Manager (APM) deployments to execute code remotely without authentication. Tracked as CVE-2026-94127, the flaw affects virtual servers configured with both an APM access policy and an OAuth profile, specifically where APM operates as an OAuth Authorization Server. items.title: ShinyHunters Allegedly Claims Breach of FBI Jobs Site and Stolen Agents’ Data
items.description: The FBI is investigating alleged unauthorized activity affecting its recruitment infrastructure after the ShinyHunters cybercrime group claimed it breached FBI systems, defaced the bureau’s jobs portal, and stole sensitive records belonging to employees and applicants. items.title: ZDI-CAN-33068: Deciso
items.description: A CVSS score 5.5 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N severity vulnerability discovered by 'Victor Riis Allingham' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2026-09-22, 1 days ago. The vendor is given until 2027-01-20 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
